title: Heterogeneous Graphs & Relation Types
interviewAnswer: Heterogeneous graphs contain different node/edge types whose relations have different semantics. Models often use relation-specific transformations or metapath/message-passing strategies.
keyPoints: Reverse edges are often explicit for directed relation flow.
why: Heterogeneous Graphs & Relation Types is a standard part of a broad data/ML curriculum because it changes how models are selected, evaluated or operated in real systems.
deepDive: Heterogeneous graphs contain different node/edge types whose relations have different semantics. Models often use relation-specific transformations or metapath/message-passing strategies. Reverse edges are often explicit for directed relation flow. Evaluation should match target relation. A strong answer connects the formal idea to validation, data requirements and failure modes instead of treating the method as a recipe.
workedExample: A marketplace graph has users, items and sellers with view, purchase and ownership edges.
commonMistakes: Choosing the technique without checking whether its assumptions match the problem.
Optimizing an offline metric without checking realistic validation slices or operational constraints.

production: In production, validate on realistic slices, track latency/cost when relevant, and monitor for distribution changes or failure modes that the offline metric can hide.
